Project

1. Select a layer in the timeline to open the Inspector panel.
2. Tap "Transform", then move the playhead to the start time.
3. Press the "+" Keyframe button to mark the first position.
4. Move the playhead and move the object.
5. Open the "Easing Curve" button to soften the motion!
3D Composition Space & Camera

1. In the timeline, select the layer you want to move into 3D space.
2. Open the Inspector and enable "TRUE 3D".
3. Use the Z axis to set the layer depth.
4. Press the Camera button in the preview tools to look from the camera's point of view!
Effect Catalog & Audio Spectrum

1. Select a layer, then press the "Effects" tile in the Inspector.\n2. Browse hundreds of effects: Chroma Key, Glow, Wave Warp, Spectrum Preset.\n3. Adjust effect parameters live with a real-time preview!
Full Resolution 60 FPS Video Export

1. Press the Export button in the top right of the editor.
2. Choose 720p, 1080p or 4K Ultra resolution.
3. Choose 30 or 60 FPS frame rate.
4. Use WebCodecs GPU Fast for super fast export right in the browser.
